relation: one contract, degree balance of a finite digraph (every vertex has equal in- and out-degree; no connectivity, looplessness, inhabitance or tour premise). Migrated: two_extremal.Eulerian (forall v, indeg v = outdeg v over classic_core.indeg) is balanced D by conversion; colouring_variants.eulerian ([forall v, indeg v == outdeg v], Boolean, file-local in-degree) is balancedb D by conversion, reflected by balancedP; X221.x221_eulerian (forall v, outdeg v = indeg v, over classic_core.indeg) is the reversed-equation view balanced_revE, a proved iff. All in-degrees are the comprehension #|[set u | u --> v]|, the public indeg. Deferred: reals_growth.eulerian (same body, but its two non-corpus EC-log rows inherit classical-reals axioms through their statements: a legacy-axiom defect, left byte-identical) and Cycle U6's multigraph eulerian (connected, even arc-end degrees), a different contract. Chromatic.foundations.alon_tarsi.at_eulerian (balance of a supplied finite set of ordered pairs) is a distinct representation, not a source of this family.
summary: Family B16 (directed degree balance, the corpus's directed "Eulerian" helpers), AXIOM-FREE REPLACEMENT of the rejected pin 6dba7ed (coordinator ruling 2026-10-03: no assumption exemption; plan section 3, invariant 4), a sibling of 6dba7ed on the same parent 2981122. The migrated helpers unfold to the public `Digraph.foundations.degree_balance`, reviewed on the rejected pin and reused byte-for-byte: `two_extremal.Eulerian` (`forall v, indeg v = outdeg v` over `classic_core.indeg`) is `balanced D` by conversion; `colouring_variants.eulerian` (`[forall v, indeg v == outdeg v]`) is `balancedb D` by conversion, reflected by `balancedP`; `X221.x221_eulerian` (`forall v, outdeg v = indeg v`) is the reversed equation, certified by the proved `balanced_revE`. The source in-degrees (`classic_core.indeg` over `Nin`, and colouring_variants' file-local comprehension) unfold to the public `indeg v := #|[set u | u --> v]|` and are unchanged; each frozen helper keeps its own, qualified. The contract is degree balance alone: no connectivity, looplessness, inhabitance or closed-tour premise is added, and `Digraph.core.oriented.outdeg` is unchanged.

API: `indeg`, `balanced`, `balancedb`, `balancedP`, `balanced_revE`, `balanced_vertex`, the degree sums and the handshake `sum_indeg_outdeg`, arcless balance, and the converse swaps. Groundings: the empty digraph, an arcless vertex, a vertex with a loop (balanced), two disjoint loops (balanced and disconnected), the digon, the directed triangle `C3`, and the single arc `TT 2`, which is not balanced. Public-only client digraph-theory/theories/examples/degree_balance.v.

Rows and chains, frozen with this family's helpers only: X221 `orientation_C4_eulerian_avoidable_statement` (arxiv:2510.11311#04) through the chain `x221_eulerian_avoidable`, with the out-degree thresholds, the out-neighbourhood selection and the subdigraph exclusion unchanged; colouring_variants `majority_3col_eulerian_statement` (arxiv:1608.03040#04, manifest phase X1); two_extremal `H6_no_full_cover` (derived:drv_twoext_h6, phase X1), complete with every guard in its order: the looplessness proof quantified first, then positive order, `strongb`, `Eulerian`, `arc_conn D = 2`, 3-connectivity of the underlying graph and the disconnected digon graph, concluding `dicolorableb D 2`. The uppercase chains are frozen over the frozen helper: `two_extremal_hajos.realises_Eulerian` inside a Section with the same `Variable realises`, so its discharged type takes the arbitrary realisation relation explicitly; `two_extremal_glue.realises_W` (the supplied tree `t` unused, as before); `glue_eul_subtype.realises_E` (same body, separate public name); `generalised_wheel.realises_gw` (loopless, Eulerian and a forest digon graph for every looplessness proof; no digon-free conjunct). `in_H2_concrete` and `conj_9_2_concrete` are unchanged parameterised public helpers and are never instantiated at a live relation inside the frozen copies.

WHOLE-PROP ENROLLMENT (root decision 2026-10-03): the two non-selected Conjecture 9.2 encodings `two_extremal_glue.conj_9_2_glued := conj_9_2_concrete realises_W` and `glue_eul_subtype.conj_9_2_glued_e := conj_9_2_concrete realises_E` are reached whole Props without a manifest row or `_statement` suffix. They are frozen over their frozen relations, certified by the complete iff lemmas `conj_9_2_glued_compat` and `conj_9_2_glued_e_compat`, enrolled honestly as `kind=statement, non_corpus=true` and listed in `additional_statements`. The current migration_report discovers only manifest rows and `_statement` names, so its check `affected statement coverage matches baseline dependencies` FAILS on this spec with exactly extra=[these two names] until the separately reviewed `additional_statements` tooling (matching_scope; design evidence/B16-assumption-diagnosis/additional-statements-design.md) is integrated. This expected pending-tooling failure is recorded here and on BOARD; the pin is not accepted for integration before that. They are not labelled chain or historical, and no temporary spec omits them.

DEFERRED LEGACY-AXIOM DEFECT, recorded as ruled: `reals_growth.eulerian` has the same body (`forall v, indeg v = outdeg v`) but is NOT migrated. Its two non-corpus EC-log rows (`ec_log_statement`, `ec_log_c6_statement`) inherit `ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_not_dec`, `ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_forall_dec`, `FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep` and `Classical_Prop.classic` through their statements' concrete reals (R, INR, log2), so any certificate of them fails the kernel assumptions audit; reals_growth.v and grounding_reals2.v stay byte-identical to the baseline 2981122, the helper is classified deferred in the registry (class legacy-axiom-defect), and the rejected pin 6dba7ed with its evidence records the attempt. It is not removed from any coverage: no migrated source reaches it, and the kernel evidence re-probes at this pin that neither EC-log statement reaches a migrated source or any constant of the public module.

Proof consumers, proof-only edits with unchanged theorem types: grounding_X221 `x221_C3_eulerian` and `x221_TT2_not_eulerian`, grounding_chi_col `eulerian_C3` and `not_eulerian_TT2` now go through the public groundings and `balancedP`; `two_extremal_glue.di_cycle_Eulerian`, `generalised_wheel.gwheel_Eulerian` and `grounding_h2_concrete.symcyc3_Eulerian` unfold the public `indeg` instead of `classic_core.indeg`/`Nin`; `glue_eul_subtype.ueglue_Eulerian` states the goal and its two Eulerian hypotheses over `classic_core.indeg` by conversion before the existing degree-union rewrites. Every other reached declaration (uppercase-complete-reach: 61 declarations in eight modules) compiles unchanged, including `H6_implies_three_connected_digonG_connected` with its explicit standing Eulerian hypothesis. grounding_reals2 is unchanged.

History: no migration snapshot references the migrated helpers, their rows or chains, so the per-row copies are complete and no Original is composed. `Cycle.conjectures.U6.eulerian` (connected multigraph with even arc-end degrees, a loop counting two) shares the normalized name and is classified deferred as a distinct undirected contract (family B17, connected/even predicate and its complete reached rows only); U6's supplied tour predicate `is_eulerian_tour` remains separate and unchanged; `Chromatic.foundations.alon_tarsi.at_eulerian` (balance of a supplied finite set of ordered pairs) is a distinct deferred representation.
